service: last-mile-translator

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs18.x
  region: ${opt:region, 'us-east-1'}
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}
  memorySize: 512
  timeout: 29
  environment:
    S3_BUCKET_NAME: ${env:S3_BUCKET_NAME}
    DYNAMODB_DOCUMENTS_TABLE: ${env:DYNAMODB_DOCUMENTS_TABLE}
    DYNAMODB_USERS_TABLE: ${env:DYNAMODB_USERS_TABLE}
    DEMO_MODE: ${env:DEMO_MODE}
    NODE_ENV: ${env:NODE_ENV}
  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - s3:PutObject
            - s3:GetObject
          Resource: arn:aws:s3:::${env:S3_BUCKET_NAME}/*
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - dynamodb:PutItem
            - dynamodb:GetItem
            - dynamodb:Query
          Resource:
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${aws:region}:${aws:accountId}:table/${env:DYNAMODB_DOCUMENTS_TABLE}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${aws:region}:${aws:accountId}:table/${env:DYNAMODB_USERS_TABLE}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${aws:region}:${aws:accountId}:table/policy-ingestion-metadata
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${aws:region}:${aws:accountId}:table/policy-ingestion-metadata/index/*
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - textract:StartDocumentAnalysis
            - textract:GetDocumentAnalysis
          Resource: '*'
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - translate:TranslateText
          Resource: '*'
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - polly:SynthesizeSpeech
          Resource: '*'
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - sns:Publish
          Resource: '*'
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - events:PutEvents
          Resource: '*'

functions:
  health:
    handler: src/lambda/handlers.healthHandler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /api/health
          method: get
          cors: true

  recentPolicies:
    handler: src/lambda/handlers.recentPoliciesHandler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /api/policies/recent
          method: get
          cors: true

  translateText:
    handler: src/lambda/handlers.translateTextHandler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /api/translate
          method: post
          cors: true

  documentUpload:
    handler: src/lambda/handlers.documentUploadHandler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /api/documents
          method: post
          cors: true

  documentGet:
    handler: src/lambda/handlers.documentGetHandler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /api/documents/{id}
          method: get
          cors: true

  translation:
    handler: src/lambda/handlers.translationHandler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /api/documents/{id}/translation
          method: get
          cors: true

  voice:
    handler: src/lambda/handlers.voiceHandler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /api/documents/{id}/voice
          method: post
          cors: true

  personalize:
    handler: src/lambda/handlers.personalizeHandler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /api/documents/{id}/personalize
          method: post
          cors: true

  compare:
    handler: src/lambda/handlers.compareHandler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /api/documents/compare
          method: post
          cors: true

  profileSave:
    handler: src/lambda/handlers.profileSaveHandler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /api/users/profile
          method: post
          cors: true

  profileGet:
    handler: src/lambda/handlers.profileGetHandler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /api/users/{userId}/profile
          method: get
          cors: true

  scheduledIngestion:
    handler: src/lambda/ingestionHandlers.scheduledIngestionHandler
    events:
      - schedule:
          rate: cron(0 2 * * ? *)
          description: Daily policy ingestion at 2 AM UTC
          enabled: true

  manualIngestion:
    handler: src/lambda/ingestionHandlers.manualIngestionHandler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /api/ingestion/manual
          method: post
          cors: true

  smsNotification:
    handler: src/lambda/ingestionHandlers.smsNotificationHandler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /api/notifications/sms
          method: post
          cors: true

  whatsappNotification:
    handler: src/lambda/ingestionHandlers.whatsappNotificationHandler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /api/notifications/whatsapp
          method: post
          cors: true

resources:
  Resources:
    PolicyIngestionMetadataTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: policy-ingestion-metadata
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: policyId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: sourceUrl
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: policyId
            KeyType: HASH
        GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
          - IndexName: url-index
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: sourceUrl
                KeyType: HASH
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
        TimeToLiveSpecification:
          AttributeName: ttl
          Enabled: true
